summary: 28-year-old male four-wheeling with his roommate in deep snow at Breck Estates near Alma became stuck with his Jeep; the roommate walked out and left him in the vehicle. A SARDOC dog team found the snow-buried Jeep with the engine running; the subject was incoherent and was walked out, refused medical treatment. Possible carbon monoxide poisoning noted by handler.
notes: SARDOC 2018 public mission summaries (parent-opened this run). Search date 2018-03-28.
